slides.headline: Every AI helper needs *an owner*
slides.sub: Without 1, nobody notices when it drifts. 3 questions settle it.

slides.title: Who checks its work?
slides.body: 1 named person checks it every day. Not "the team".
slides.cost: Ask: whose name is on it?

slides.title: What can it do alone?
slides.body: A tracking question, yes. A refund, no. Write the line down.
slides.cost: Ask: where does it need a yes?

slides.title: What does it report?
slides.body: A short daily note: what it handled, what it passed on.
slides.cost: Ask: what lands in your inbox?

slides.headline: Want the *owner sheet*?
slides.sub: Comment it and we'll DM you.
